Bug_Details:
The referenced methods have names that differ only by capitalization.
This is very confusing because if the capitalization were
identical then one of the methods would override the other.
Bug_Explanation: The methods 'calculateValue' and 'CalculateValue' have names that differ only by capitalization, making it confusing as to which method is being called. If the capitalization were identical, one would override the other.
Trigger_Explanation: The test cases call the showBug method from the ConfusingMethodNames class, which internally calls both calculateValue and CalculateValue methods. The difference in method names only by capitalization leads to confusion in method invocation, resulting in unexpected behavior which causes the assertEquals to fail.
